label: Main: Culture inside the ideational domain
note: Ideational power read broadly as meaning-making: the church, the academy and cultural production together.

label: Culture dropped: ideational = religion and the academy
note: Ideational power read narrowly as clerical and credentialled authority. Writers, performers and journalists leave the universe.

label: Culture as a fifth domain of its own
note: Cultural production separated from clerical and credentialled authority, so a writer who is also an academic now crosses a boundary.

label: Only Culture (core) counts as ideational
note: Writers and composers produce ideas; performers, journalists and designers are dropped.

label: Exploration & Invention moved to the ideational domain
note: Inventors and explorers read as knowledge producers instead of creators of productive assets. Everything else as in the main specification.
